body.statement:
Open question. On each constant-rank relative-interior stratum of the observed-law image of \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{face}}\), construct an explicit finite-dimensional parameterization \(p(\zeta)\), compute
\[
 S_P=\operatorname{diag}(p)^{-1}\frac{\partial p(\zeta)}{\partial\zeta^\top},
\]
identify the constrained score space \(\operatorname{col}(S_P)\), and determine for each reported direction whether
\[
 \{I-\Pi_{\operatorname{col}(S_P)}\}G_p\neq0.
\]
No restricted-model efficiency bound or attaining estimator is asserted without that parameterization, rank analysis, and projection calculation.
body.justification: This is now an explicit open question, not a theorem: restricted-model efficiency requires an observed-law parameterization, its finite score Jacobian, and a constant-rank projection calculation.
body.gap: The present paper derives only the saturated multinomial canonical gradient; it does not yet characterize the smaller restricted Markov tangent space.
body.consumer: A future restricted-likelihood analysis must compute \(S_P\) and test the residual projection before claiming a sharper bound or an attaining estimator.

obligation.what_is_open: For every constant-rank relative-interior stratum of the observed-law image of \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{face}}\), construct a chart \(p(\zeta)\) whose differential exhausts that stratum's restricted tangent space, account for observationally equivalent latent representations, and evaluate for every reported direction \(a\) whether \((I-\Pi_{\operatorname{col}(S_P)})a^\top G_p\) is nonzero.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen core supplies only prospective symbols \(\zeta\) and \(S_P\), not coordinates for cohort masses, type masses, initial laws, date-specific transition rows, their common-kernel equalities, or their support constraints. More importantly, \(\text{thm:active-frontier-recovery}\) deliberately leaves the type allocation of date-\(1\) absorbers unidentified. Thus the natural latent-primitive map is noninjective, may have representation-dependent Jacobians, and can meet itself or change rank at boundary strata. A derivative at one arbitrarily chosen latent representation is not proved to span the tangent space of the observed-law image. Until an atlas or an equivalent finite system of observable equality constraints is constructed and its rank is proved, \(\operatorname{col}(S_P)\) is undetermined. Projecting onto a postulated column space would assume the central step of the open question.
obligation.attempted: A natural four-wave candidate parameterizes each legal observed cell p_{d,x0,x1,x2,x3} by cohort mass, known-J type masses, initial laws, and the H_j, Q_j, and R_j^d transition factors subject to stochastic-row and common-kernel equalities. Differentiating this finite polynomial map gives a candidate Jacobian. This does not close the question: unreachable rows, label equivalences, and arbitrary type allocations among paths absorbed by date 1 yield nonunique primitive points above the same observed law, so the derivative at one representation is not proved to span the tangent space of the full observed-law stratum. The earlier projection calculation was conditional on precisely that missing equality.
obligation.partial_result:
For any supplied \(C^1\) chart \(p(\zeta)\) on a fixed positive support \(\mathcal S_0\), let
\[
 W=\operatorname{diag}\{p_s:s\in\mathcal S_0\},\qquad
 A=\frac{\partial p(\zeta)}{\partial\zeta^\top},\qquad
 S=W^{-1}A.
\]
For a differentiable path \(\zeta_t\) through \(\zeta\), direct differentiation gives \(\dot p=A\dot\zeta\) and hence the score \(h=W^{-1}\dot p=S\dot\zeta\). If the chart has locally constant rank and its image is the whole chosen stratum, its score space is therefore \(\operatorname{col}(S)\). For any reported linear direction \(a\), put \(g_a(s)=a^\top G_p(s)\). The weighted least-squares projection and its squared residual are the computable quantities
\[
 \Pi_{\operatorname{col}(S)}g_a
 =W^{-1}A(A^\top W^{-1}A)^\dagger A^\top g_a,
\]
\[
 \left\|(I-\Pi_{\operatorname{col}(S)})g_a\right\|_{L_2(P)}^2
 =g_a^\top Wg_a-(A^\top g_a)^\top(A^\top W^{-1}A)^\dagger(A^\top g_a).
\]
Consequently the residual is nonzero exactly when the last display is positive, equivalently when \(g_a\notin\operatorname{col}(W^{-1}A)\). This closes the projection calculation conditional on a valid full-stratum chart, but the construction and rank certification of that chart remain open.
